metadata.method_name: Prompt-suffix displacement predictor of idea bans (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct)
metadata.engine_note: All screen + confirmation generations: vLLM 0.31.0 (bf16, T=0.7, top-p 1, top-k off, max_tokens 768, per-request seed). Transplant cells: HF transformers custom KV-cached loop with common-random-number sampling, CodeStop on, max_new 640; compared only with same-engine HF references.

C2c.interpretation: Suffix-state transplant, restore, suffix ceiling (all 35 layers) and Stolfo-style all-position add all recover ~0; a decode-time attention knockout of the ban sentence (added after pre-registration, exploratory) restores placebo behaviour: the ban is read from the sentence tokens during generation, not from the prompt-final state (fallback F5).

notes: Screen fits use the stored iteration-1 v1 labels (relabel check 200/200), which are under a parallel audit.
Predictors were frozen with sha256 + git commit before any confirmation generation; per-condition predictions were frozen before any confirmation BAN was generated (gen scripts assert all hashes).
beta for B was selected at 19.75 on a pre-registered grid [-20, 20]: near the grid edge; reported as is.
Single model family (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct); one prompt wording per confirmation ban.

Probe band selection used generated-window probes on baseline+forced samples; the probe score is high at every layer (forced prompts make classes separable), so the band choice (32-34) is weakly determined.
Exploratory additions beyond the plan: KNOCKOUT_BAN / KNOCKOUT_PLACEBO_SENT transplant cells (4 bans, n=60).
No plan cuts were needed (all pairs, T4, controls, transplant n=60 with 5 random draws were run).
metadata.predict_fields: predict_* = frozen predicted probability of the OBSERVED label under each predictor (iia=A, disp=B, embed=D, lexical=D3, nested=C, comention=E); absent for placebo blocks, T4 baseline/forced/comention.
